english_translations.sahih_international: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
english_translations.yusuf_ali: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
english_translations.shakir: For the protection of the Qureaish--
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: For God's favors to them during their summer and winter journeys,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (It is a great Grace and Protection from Allah), for the taming of the Quraish,

ayahs.translation_bn: (অর্থাৎ) শীত ও গ্রীষ্মে তাদের বিদেশ সফরে অভ্যস্ত হওয়ার (কারণে)

ayahs.conventional_en: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

ayahs.meta_bn: ঋতুভিত্তিক বাণিজ্য কাফেলা: শীত ও গ্রীষ্মকালীন বাণিজ্য সফরের সুসংগত সমন্বয়

english_translations.sahih_international: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
english_translations.pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
english_translations.shakir: Their protection during their trading caravans in the winter and the summer--
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Quraish should worship the Lord of this House.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (And with all those Allah's Grace and Protections for their taming, We cause) the (Quraish) caravans to set forth safe in winter (to the south), and in summer (to the north without any fear),
english_translations.arberry: their composing for the winter and summer caravan!

ayahs.translation_bn: তাদের কর্তব্য হল এই (কা‘বা) ঘরের রবের ‘ইবাদাত করা,
ayahs.translation_en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
ayahs.conventional_en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
ayahs.conventional_bn: তাদের কর্তব্য হল এই (কা‘বা) ঘরের রবের ‘ইবাদাত করা,

english_translations.shakir: So let them serve the Lord of this House

ayahs.transliteration: alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin waāmanahum min khawfin
ayahs.translation_bn: যিনি তাদেরকে (কা‘বা ঘরের খাদিম হওয়ার কারণে নির্বিঘ্নে ব্যবসা-বাণিজ্যের মাধ্যমে) ক্ষুধায় খাদ্য দিচ্ছেন এবং তাদেরকে ভয়-ভীতি হতে নিরাপদ করেছেন।
ayahs.translation_en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
ayahs.conventional_en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যিনি তাদেরকে (কা‘বা ঘরের খাদিম হওয়ার কারণে নির্বিঘ্নে ব্যবসা-বাণিজ্যের মাধ্যমে) ক্ষুধায় খাদ্য দিচ্ছেন এবং তাদেরকে ভয়-ভীতি হতে নিরাপদ করেছেন।
ayahs.meta_bn: অন্নসংস্থান ও ভয়হীনতার নিরাপত্তা: যিনি ক্ষুধায় আহার দিয়েছেন এবং ভয়ভীতি থেকে সুরক্ষিত রেখেছেন
ayahs.meta_en: Universal Metabolic Sustenance & Total Fear-Shielding Protocol
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: The two universal sociological foundations of civilizational stability: food security (ṭa'ām min jū') and psychological/physical security (amān min khawf).

english_translations.sahih_international: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
english_translations.pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
english_translations.shakir: Who feeds them against hunger and gives them security against fear.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and has made them secure from fear.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.
english_translations.arberry: who has fed them against hunger and secured them from fear.
